# **For the substance you picked, find out…**

Why it’s useful in electronics, and what items you own may contain them

| Energy Storage (Batteries) like lead-acid batteries (SLI batteries) which powers car ignition,  provide backup energy for telecommunications,  Also is pretty stable, cost-effective storage for renewable energy systems. Has high density, with a effective barrier against X-rays and gamma radiation. It is widely used in medical equipment, dental offices, nuclear facilities, and scientific labs. Almost all electronic devices, TV, circuit boards in many devices, smoke alarm, keyboards |
| :---- |

How it’s mined or extracted

| Both mined (as ore) and extracted (via smelting) Mining: Deposits are extracted through underground mining using drills and explosives. Extracting: primarily extracted from galena ore through a multi-step pyrometallurgical process that needs for crushing, flotation concentration, sintering (roasting), and reduction in a blast furnace.  |
| :---- |

Where in the world it’s mined

| China, Australia, the United States (mainly Alaska, Missouri, and Idaho), Peru, and Mexico |
| :---- |

Harms it causes to a person who comes in contact with it (if any)

| Cardiovascular disease, hypertension, and reproductive issues |
| :---- |

Harms to the surrounding environment of extracting it (if any)

| Lead in fumes from metal smelting, battery manufacturing, and some factories became airborne and then mixed with soil |
